TC-07/S08.title: A task closed by dictation (Save & Extract) shows as completed, with the visit it was closed on
TC-07/S08.detail: Hospital: 'Repeat BMP in the morning' closed by Save & Extract → under Finished Tasks with its patient, 'Done Oct 20' (server day; Hospital reading of Q3), 'Order PT evaluation' pending above — pass. Nursing Home, one earlier visit, 'Recheck INR' closed by Save & Extract: (a) as the matrix seeds it (snfVisitDates only, no course ledger, no pre-round today) → 'Done Oct 20', no visit at all (stored doneVisit undefined); (b) ledger 'Visit 1 · Oct 13' and no pre-round today → 'Done Oct 20 · Visit 1' (stored doneVisit 1) although today is visit 2; (c) after today's pre-round Save Note (ledger gets 'Visit 2 · Oct 20: Pre-rounded.') → 'Done Oct 20 · Visit 2' — pass. The server stamps the LAST visit on the course ledger (convex/lib/taskStamps.ts + lastVisitNumber), so a dictation closing a task before today's pre-round names the previous visit, and a resident with no ledger line gets none. Same in TC-22/S03 (first visit, typed tasks): 'Done Oct 20' with no visit.
TC-07/S08.stated: P0: UAT TC-07 ER 3 / TFA-92585 AC 8 'Tasks closed by dictation show as completed, with the visit they were closed on'
